messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017 [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- INC-2025-017: auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02; the root cause was an expired intermediate certificate [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Decision: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The handover note of 2025-06-11 wrongly recorded Cinder as the owner of the notifier [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
- The handover note of 2026-02-11 wrongly recorded Dune as the owner of feature-flags [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- Decision: auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023 [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The handover note of 2025-06-09 wrongly recorded Boreal as the owner of billing-api [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
- Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004 [decision; valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages [decision; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- INC-2025-004: the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01; the root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The ledger deploys only on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger deploys only on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- Decision: reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- Decision: webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off [constraint; valid 2025-07-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-29]
- Atlas noticed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]

Question: Which note records the decision that certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, and when was it written?
